item.title: Trust Your Gut (402 players | $7.99)
item.description:
Release Date: Nov 18, 2026 | Price: $7.99 | Peak Seen Players: 402

You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.
